title: Indicator 2 — daysWithDelay options and WL mapping (REQ-03-02)
context:
Why: REQ-03-02 — Indicator 2. Pure ES module (Node 18+, no dependencies, no I/O; see CLAUDE.md) mapping a dropdown option label to a Watchlist level (WL). Do TDD with node:test + node:assert/strict.
Files: src/indicators/daysWithDelay.mjs (create) and test/indicators/daysWithDelay.test.mjs (create). Touch nothing else; do not import the sibling indicator module (parallel card).
Exports (exactly these, named exports, no default): `export const DAYS_WITH_DELAY_OPTIONS` = Object.freeze(["no delay", "<=3 days", ">3 days", ">60 days", ">90 days"]) (array of strings, this order; frozen, push throws TypeError); `export function daysWithDelayWl(option)` synchronous, pure, returns the WL number.
Mapping (C2): "no delay"→0, "<=3 days"→0, ">3 days"→2, ">60 days"→3, ">90 days"→4 (results in option order: [0,0,2,3,4]). NOTE: the requirement text writes "≤3 days" but C1 fixes the ASCII string "<=3 days"; "≤3 days" is INVALID → RangeError.
Input handling (C1, C5): if typeof option !== 'string' (incl. undefined, null, numbers, booleans, arrays, objects, String objects) throw RangeError. Otherwise option.trim() (String.prototype.trim: strips all JS whitespace incl. NBSP/tabs/newlines, never inner whitespace), then EXACT case-sensitive match against the allowed labels; anything else (empty, whitespace-only, wrong case, inner spaces, different glyphs, near-misses) throws RangeError. Never return a WL for invalid input and never throw another error type.
Error message (X-error-message): non-empty, names the offending value (e.g. via String()/JSON.stringify safe for symbols/objects) and may list allowed options; tests assert only instanceof RangeError (and optionally message non-empty/contains value).
Do not mutate input/state or the options list; unit tests must verify DAYS_WITH_DELAY_OPTIONS unchanged after calls. Out of scope: Indicator 1, UI, counting delays, any other indicator, src/ratings, dependencies.
acceptance: AC-1: DAYS_WITH_DELAY_OPTIONS deep-equals ["no delay","<=3 days",">3 days",">60 days",">90 days"], is an array, Object.isFrozen is true, push throws TypeError
AC-3: ">3 days" → 2, ">60 days" → 3, ">90 days" → 4; options mapped in order give [0,0,2,3,4]
AC-4: whitespace is trimmed: "  >60 days  " → 3, "\t>3 days\n" → 2, NBSP-wrapped ">90 days" → 4, " no delay " → 0

AC-5: RangeError (only) for ">3 Days", ">3  days", "> 3 days", "", "   ", "3 days", ">3days", "≤3 days", "<=3 days.", ">30 days", ">91 days" and non-strings undefined, null, 3, 0, true, [], ["no delay"], {}, new String("no delay")
AC-6: thrown error is instanceof RangeError with non-empty message naming the offending value
AC-11: module exports exactly DAYS_WITH_DELAY_OPTIONS and daysWithDelayWl; function is sync and pure (same input → same output, options unchanged after calls); no imports/dependencies
AC-12: test/indicators/daysWithDelay.test.mjs passes under node --test; only files in src/indicators/ and test/indicators/ added; no Indicator 1 logic or UI
